label: KODAK PROFESSIONAL PORTRA 160
source: Kodak Alaris technical data E-4051 (February 2016, revised 2-16), curves read from the PDF's vector paths (page 4)

spectral_sensitivity.unit: log10 sensitivity (reciprocal exposure, erg/cm2, for density 0.2 above D-min)

print_grain_index.note: Kodak Print Grain Index (diffuse printing, 14 in viewing distance); RMS granularity not published

notes: Approximate digitization; not supplied or endorsed by Kodak Alaris / Eastman Kodak Company. Sensitometry x = (log H - Log H Ref) / log10(2), Log H Ref -1.051 lux-seconds read from the characteristic-curve chart; density is Status M including base, made monotone by running maximum. Spectral sensitivity kept only where the curve is drawn on the chart; wavelengths where a curve is not drawn are omitted, so a channel's wavelength list can be non-contiguous. Individual dye curves not published; dye_density holds only the published midscale neutral and minimum density curves. Characteristic curves: Exposure Daylight, Densitometry Status M, Log H Ref -1.051 (no process line); density axis calibrated from the drawn tick marks (1.0 and 3.0), which put 0.0 1.1 pt below the drawn frame bottom. Spectral sensitivity: Daylight, effective exposure 1/50 s, Status M, density 0.2 above D-min; this chart's log-sensitivity axis runs -1.0 to 3.0. Spectral dye density: typical densities for D-min and a midscale neutral subject (no process line). Print Grain Index table as published (page 3): '<25' entries are kept as 'less than 25' (25 is the visual threshold), no print sizes in cm are published, 4 x 5 in magnifications listed as 1.2X, 2X, 4X. The MTF chart (Exposure Daylight, Process C-41) is not digitized.

scan.note: fitted to 91 Lomography community scans (lomography.com/films/871916076-kodak-portra-160/photos, recent, pages 1-2, 2026-11-11); colours of real scans, not manufacturer data
